questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe sustainability considerations in the cloud
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Deallocation: stopping or deallocating unused resources to reduce unnecessary consumption.
Deallocation: the potential for large cloud providers to use infrastructure more efficiently than many isolated environments.
Right-sizing: using operational data to identify waste and optimization opportunities.
Right-sizing: matching provisioned resource capacity to actual workload needs.
Autoscaling for sustainability: a service availability commitment that can include an uptime guarantee.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Right-sizing — matching provisioned resource capacity to actual workload needs; and Deallocation — stopping or deallocating unused resources to reduce unnecessary consumption.
